project.heading: Project control room
project.subtitle: Omnicon Production Monitoring & Management, pilot on {pilot}
project.gaugeNote: Weighted; in progress counts as half
project.atRiskOne: 1 activity in progress waits on an open question.
project.atRiskMany: {count} activities in progress wait on an open question.
project.onTrackReason: Nothing blocked. {progress} in progress; open questions are not blocking current work.
project.phasesIntro: The project runs like a line: each phase feeds the next. Select a phase to see its activities.
project.selectHint: Select a status to move it forward
project.noActivities: No activities in this phase yet. Use Add activity to create the first one.
project.archIntro: From the machine’s controller to the operator’s screen. Select a layer to see what it holds and how it talks to the next one.
project.talksTo: Talks to the next layer through
project.qaIntro: Ask in the last row and press Enter, or paste several rows from Excel. Answering a question closes it; tick it as a decision when the answer sets a rule for the project.
project.answerPlaceholder: Waiting for an answer. Click to answer
project.decisionLocked: Answer first to mark as a decision
project.newQuestionPlaceholder: Type a question and press Enter, or paste rows from Excel (question, tab, answer)
project.newHint: Enter adds the row. Shift+Enter for a new line.
project.emptyAll: No questions yet. Type the first one below.
project.emptyOpen: Nothing is waiting for an answer.
project.emptyDecisions: No decisions yet. Answer a question and tick Decision.
project.modalEntryPlaceholder: What changed, what was decided, or what this activity must deliver
project.modalDefinitionPlaceholder: What this activity must deliver, even before it starts
project.modalGoalPlaceholder: What this phase delivers when it is complete
project.deletePhaseText: “{name}” and its {count} activities will be removed. Questions and decisions linked to them stay, without an activity.
project.deleteActivityText: “{name}” and its {count} log entries will be removed. Linked questions and decisions stay, without an activity.
